# Contributing to TradeX

Thank you for helping. Bug reports, ideas and pull requests are welcome.

- **Bugs and ideas:** open an issue. Say what you did, what you expected and what happened (screenshot welcome).
- **Security problems:** do not open a public issue. Use "Report a vulnerability" on the Security tab (see
  [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)).
- **Code:** read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) (how the project runs and how to add a chart source), keep changes small and
  focused, and test them on the free feeds before you open a pull request.

## Contribution terms (please read before your first pull request)

By opening a pull request or otherwise sending code, text or images to this project, you agree that:

1. **It is yours to give.** You wrote it, or you have the right to send it under these terms (the Developer
   Certificate of Origin 1.1, https://developercertificate.org). Sign every commit with `git commit -s`, which adds
   a `Signed-off-by:` line with your name and e-mail.
2. **Everyone gets it under the AGPL-3.0-only**, the same licence as the rest of TradeX.
3. **The maintainer may also use it under other terms.** You grant Saifullah Shafin a perpetual, worldwide,
   non-exclusive, royalty-free, irrevocable licence to use, copy, change, sublicense and distribute your
   contribution under any licence, including closed-source and commercial terms. You keep your copyright and can
   use your own work however you like.
4. **No third-party code with another licence** unless you say so in the pull request and it is compatible with
   the AGPL-3.0. Never include code or data you are not allowed to share.

Term 3 lets TradeX offer paid hosted extras and change its licence later without having to contact every
contributor. Without it, a project with many contributors can never change its licence.

## Name and logo
Contributing does not give a right to use the TradeX name or logo. See [TRADEMARK.md](TRADEMARK.md).
